<meta name="description" content="The MX-0808-KIT v2 gets a make over, sharing many of the same powerful features of version 1, but with a vision of lite commercial installations in mind. Offering the same transmissions of 4K UHD up to 35m/115ft, but now up to 8 HDBaseT outputs with included receivers. Additionally, version 2 is equipped with 4 mirrored outputs, which can be paired with any of our HAOC hybrid optical HDMI cables to connect to 4 additional screens. Also new and fitting are 4 balanced analog audio outputs 2ch support to connect to ceiling/over-hanging speakers or to an audio amplifier. Lastly, still enjoy the same great features of version 1, including CEC triggering, A/V mute and standby mode to extend the life of the matrix during downtime.          "/>

<ul>
<li><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal Table Content" data-ccp-parastyle-defn="{"ObjectId":"c66197e6-54b9-4b35-a200-d2b9027e4221|52","ClassId":1073872969,"Properties":[469775450,"Normal Table Content",201340122,"2",134234082,"true",134233614,"true",469778129,"NormalTableContent",335572020,"1",201342447,"5",201342448,"1",469777841,"Roboto Lt",469777842,"Arial",469777843,"Calibri",469777844,"Roboto Lt",469769226,"Roboto Lt,Arial,Calibri",268442635,"18",335559740,"240",201341983,"0",335559739,"0",469778324,"Normal",469778325,"["Normal Table Heading"]"]}">True 8×8 matrix with 8 HDBaseT zones and 4 </span><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal Table Content">mirrored HDMI outputs</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
<li><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal Table Content">SmartEDID feature also dynamically detects display/source capabilities and automatically outputs the highest possible resolution</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
<li><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal Table Content">Ad</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal Table Content">ditional EDID management through DIP switches for global setting or via WebUI for independent management of EDID per source</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
<li><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal Table Content">E</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal Table Content">mbedded WyreStorm WebUI enables simple source switching and installer set-up & configuration</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
<li><span data-contrast="auto">WebUI includes full EDID management to copy EDID from connected devices</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"201341983":0,"335559685":1752,"335559739":144,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
<li><span data-contrast="auto">Independent user control interface with separate password-protected installer settings</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"201341983":0,"335559685":1752,"335559739":144,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
<li><span data-contrast="auto">Personalize switching interface with source and output labelling</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"201341983":0,"335559685":1752,"335559739":144,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
<li><span data-contrast="auto">Hide unused I/O for cleaner appearance and navigation</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"201341983":0,"335559685":1752,"335559739":144,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
<li><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal Table Content">API triggered standby mode puts unit into low power state during downtime</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>

Home / Matrix Solution 8×8 4K UHD HDBaseT Matrix Kit SKU: MX-0808-KIT v2 Login as a partner to view prices The MX-0808-KIT v2 gets a make over, sharing many of the same powerful features of version 1, but with a vision of lite commercial installations in mind. Offering the same transmissions of 4K UHD up to 35m/115ft, but now up to 8 HDBaseT outputs with included receivers. Additionally, version 2 is equipped with 4 mirrored outputs, which can be paired with any of our HAOC hybrid optical HDMI cables to connect to 4 additional screens. Also new and fitting are 4 balanced analog audio outputs 2ch support to connect to ceiling/over-hanging speakers or to an audio amplifier. Lastly, still enjoy the same great features of version 1, including CEC triggering, A/V mute and standby mode to extend the life of the matrix during downtime. Displaying captivating digital menus or company messaging corresponding with powerful distribution of balanced audio makes this kit a few WyreStorm Hybrid Active Optical Cables away from a full AV matrix solution in one purchase. 	<div id="text-3944947963" class="text">
		
<p><strong>Use with RXV-70-4K-G2 for 70m/230ft transmission of 2160p 4:4:4/60</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>4K HDR HDBaseT 8×8 Matrix Switch, supporting:
<ul>
<li>Content up to 4K/60 4:4:4 & RGB 8-bit</li>
<li>The latest HDR standards, including 60Hz HDR-10 & HLG and Dolby Vision™ at 30Hz</li>
<li>HDCP 2.2 encryption technology ensuring compatibility with the latest 4K UHD content and sources</li>
<li>HD Multichannel audio up to DTS:X and Dolby Atmos™ to all outputs</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Proprietary compression algorithm enables 60Hz 4K UHD content (4:4:4 or HDR) to be sent over HDBaseT to 70m/230ft</li>
<li>4 HDMI outputs mirroring HDBaseT Outputs 1-4 for connecting additional slave screens, projectors or AVR’s</li>
<li>HDMI Inputs and HDMI outputs support bandwidths of up to 18Gbps</li>
<li>8 Assignable audio outputs allow audio to be independently de-embedded from sources or outputs via Toslink optical</li>
<li>API controlled standby mode allows the matrix to enter a low power state when not in use, cutting power consumption by up to 34%</li>
<li>Automatic (signal sensing) or manual (API operated) CEC power triggering of all connected screens or projectors (CEC compatibility required)</li>
<li>A/V Mute function gives complete distribution control to a user allowing the signal to any zone to be independently switched off</li>
<li>SmartEDID™ feature also dynamically detects display/source capabilities and automatically outputs the highest possible resolution</li>
<li>Additional EDID management through DIP switches for global setting or via WebUI for independent management of EDID per source</li>
<li>Embedded WyreStorm WebUI enables simple source switching and installer set-up & configuration</li>
<li>WebUI includes full EDID management to read, copy, store or import EDID from connected devices and different EDID’s can be assigned to each connected source device</li>
<li>API triggered standby mode puts unit into low power state during downtime</li>
<li>Flexible control options – front panel buttons, infrared remote control, local IR, RS-232, Telnet or WebUI</li>
<li>3.5mm jack input for receiving local IR commands out of line-of-sight</li>
<li>Simple switching matrix remote control included, which can be learned into a universal remote handset to allow the control of multiple devices from one handset</li>
<li>2-way IR for far-end device control from control system or source control from a zone</li>
<li>Option for end-user WebUI switching interface</li>
<li>Compact 1U chassis with adjustable depth rack mounting brackets included</li>
<li>Can be combined with WyreStorm EXP-CON-DAC-D digital audio converter to downmix Dolby Digital 5.1 content to mix stereo and surround sound zones</li>
<li>Capable of transmitting content to 50m/164ft using WyreStorm HAOC range of hybrid optical HDMI cables</li>
<li>*The ability to send custom CEC commands when standard CEC commands aren’t compatible</li>
<li>*RS-232 routing over HDBaseT allows discrete control of all connected display devices</li>
<li><strong>*Version 3 model required.</strong></li>
</ul>

	<div id="text-4116792523" class="text">
		
<p><strong>Use with RXV-70-4K-G2 for 70m/230ft transmission of 2160p 4:4:4/60</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>4K HDR HDBaseT 8×8 Matrix Switch, supporting:
<ul>
<li>Content up to 4K/60 4:4:4 & RGB 8-bit</li>
<li>The latest HDR standards, including 60Hz HDR-10 & HLG and Dolby Vision™ at 30Hz</li>
<li>HDCP 2.2 encryption technology ensuring compatibility with the latest 4K UHD content and sources</li>
<li>HD Multichannel audio up to DTS:X and Dolby Atmos™ to all outputs</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Proprietary compression algorithm enables 60Hz 4K UHD content (4:4:4 or HDR) to be sent over HDBaseT to 70m/230ft</li>
<li>4 HDMI outputs mirroring HDBaseT Outputs 1-4 for connecting additional slave screens, projectors or AVR’s</li>
<li>HDMI Inputs and HDMI outputs support bandwidths of up to 18Gbps</li>
<li>8 Assignable audio outputs allow audio to be independently de-embedded from sources or outputs via Toslink optical</li>
<li>API controlled standby mode allows the matrix to enter a low power state when not in use, cutting power consumption by up to 34%</li>
<li>Automatic (signal sensing) or manual (API operated) CEC power triggering of all connected screens or projectors (CEC compatibility required)</li>
<li>A/V Mute function gives complete distribution control to a user allowing the signal to any zone to be independently switched off</li>
<li>SmartEDID™ feature also dynamically detects display/source capabilities and automatically outputs the highest possible resolution</li>
<li>Additional EDID management through DIP switches for global setting or via WebUI for independent management of EDID per source</li>
<li>Embedded WyreStorm WebUI enables simple source switching and installer set-up & configuration</li>
<li>WebUI includes full EDID management to read, copy, store or import EDID from connected devices and different EDID’s can be assigned to each connected source device</li>
<li>API triggered standby mode puts unit into low power state during downtime</li>
<li>Flexible control options – front panel buttons, infrared remote control, local IR, RS-232, Telnet or WebUI</li>
<li>3.5mm jack input for receiving local IR commands out of line-of-sight</li>
<li>Simple switching matrix remote control included, which can be learned into a universal remote handset to allow the control of multiple devices from one handset</li>
<li>2-way IR for far-end device control from control system or source control from a zone</li>
<li>Option for end-user WebUI switching interface</li>
<li>Compact 1U chassis with adjustable depth rack mounting brackets included</li>
<li>Can be combined with WyreStorm EXP-CON-DAC-D digital audio converter to downmix Dolby Digital 5.1 content to mix stereo and surround sound zones</li>
<li>Capable of transmitting content to 50m/164ft using WyreStorm HAOC range of hybrid optical HDMI cables</li>
<li>*The ability to send custom CEC commands when standard CEC commands aren’t compatible</li>
<li>*RS-232 routing over HDBaseT allows discrete control of all connected display devices</li>
<li><strong>*Version 3 model required.</strong></li>
</ul>

		(function ($) {

				$(document).on('keyup', '#search-lightbox .dgwt-wcas-search-wrapp .dgwt-wcas-search-input', function () {
					if (this.value.length >= 3) {
						if (!$(this).closest('.dgwt-wcas-search-wrapp').hasClass('dgwt-wcas-flatsome-up')) {
							setTimeout(function () {
								$(window).trigger('resize.autocomplete');

						$(this).closest('.dgwt-wcas-search-wrapp').addClass('dgwt-wcas-flatsome-up');
					}
				});

				var refreshDropdownPosition;
				var style = '';
				var positioning = false;
				$(document).on('mouseenter', '.header-search-dropdown a', function (e) {
					if (positioning) {
						return;
					}

					setTimeout(function () {
						var pos = $(e.target).closest('.header-search').find('.nav-dropdown').attr('style');

						if (typeof pos == 'string' && pos.length > 0) {
							style = pos;
						}

						refreshDropdownPosition = setInterval(function () {
							if ($('body').hasClass('dgwt-wcas-open') && style.length > 0) {
								$('.nav-dropdown').attr('style', style);
							}

							if (!$('body').hasClass('dgwt-wcas-open') && !$('.header-search').hasClass('current-dropdown')) {
								clearInterval(refreshDropdownPosition);
								$('.nav-dropdown').removeAttr('style');
								style = '';
								positioning = false;
							}

						}, 10)
					}, 400);

					positioning = true;
				});

							formWrapper.find('.dgwt-wcas-close')[0].click();
						}

						// Recalc button positions.
						const plugin = formWrapper.find('.dgwt-wcas-search-input').data('autocomplete');

					}, 300);
				});

							}

	<div id="text-39696721" class="text">
		
<ul>
<li>HDBaseT™ Class B transmission of 4K HDR up to 35m/115ft and 1080p @60Hz 36bit up to 70m/230ft</li>
<li>Full UHD 4K transmission supporting HDMI 2.0 video standards</li>
<li>Transmits discreet wide-band bidirectional IR/RS-232 control signals together with HDMI over a single Cat5e/6 cable</li>
<li>Low profile chassis of 15mm for easier, more convenient installations behind screens at display zones</li>
<li>Supports 2ch PCM and 7.1 multichannel audio up to DTS-X and Dolby Atmos</li>

Home / HDMI Extender HDMI Single Gang In-Wall HDBaseT Transmitter SKU: TX-35-IW Login as a partner to view prices The TX-35-IW provides simple transmission of remote HDMI sources. Pair with the RX-35-POH for simple yet effective signal extension of 4K UHD content. The TX-35-IW uses standardized HDBaseT and PoH technology, meaning that it is compatible with many WyreStorm models including presentation receivers or the H2XC series of matrix switchers. The TX-35-IW is great for remote input applications including education environments such as training rooms or huddle spaces. It can be remotely powered from a compatible HDBaseT receiver and features IR and RS-232 control signal passthrough.
